chain.title: Bottle the River
chain.desc: One water bucket crafts straight into 8 Fresh Water, and nearly every pot recipe in HarvestCraft asks for it. This is the cheapest ingredient in the whole mod - grab a stack's worth early.

chain.title: The Pot
chain.desc: A copper ingot and sticks make the first of nine kitchen tools. Tools sit in the crafting grid and are never consumed - one pot boils salt, stock, soups and fried food for the rest of the game.

chain.title: Boil Off Some Salt
chain.desc: Pot plus Fresh Water gives salt, the seasoning half the mod's recipes quietly demand - dough, cheese, jerky, fries all want it. The pot comes back, so salt effectively costs only water.

chain.title: The Grinder
chain.desc: Andesite and a stick. The grinder mills grain into flour, beans into cocoa powder and raw meat into ground meat - it is the gateway to both the bakery and the burger lines.

chain.title: Mill Your First Flour
chain.desc: Grinder plus any grain - wheat works, so do barley, oats or rice from the crops mod. Flour feeds dough, batter and fried chicken; you will burn through it faster than any other ingredient.

chain.title: The Mixing Bowl
chain.desc: Planks and a stick. The bowl mixes dough, batter, cream, ice cream and mashed potatoes - the wet-ingredients workhorse of the kitchen.

chain.title: Knead the Dough
chain.desc: Bowl, flour, water and salt make 2 dough. Dough becomes bread, pies, pasta and pizza bases - it is the single most reused intermediate in all of HarvestCraft, so make it in bulk.

chain.title: The Bakeware
chain.desc: Eight terracotta in a ring. Bakeware turns one dough into a whole bread - far cheaper than three wheat - and bakes every pie, cake, muffin and cracker from here on.

chain.title: Milk by the Carton
chain.desc: A milk bucket splits into 8 Fresh Milk. Butter, cheese, batter, caramel and yogurt all drink from this supply, so keep a cow close to the kitchen.

chain.title: Churn Butter
chain.desc: Pot plus milk. Butter is the difference between plain bread and toast, and it hides inside mashed potatoes, pancakes and most of the pastry recipes coming up.

chain.title: Make Cheese
chain.desc: Pot, milk and your homemade salt. Cheese unlocks every burger upgrade, grilled cheese, mac n cheese and pizza - it is the most-wanted animal product in the mod.

chain.title: Whisk Up Batter
chain.desc: Bowl, flour, milk and an egg give 2 batter. Batter is the base of donuts, pancakes, waffles and cheesecake - the sweet half of the kitchen runs on it.

chain.title: The Skillet
chain.desc: Copper and sticks again. The skillet fries: toast, eggs, burgers, pancakes and grilled sandwiches all happen here. With pot, bowl and bakeware you now own the core four tools.

chain.title: Toast
chain.desc: Skillet, bread and butter give 2 toast. Modest on its own, but toast is the base for jelly toast and the breakfast plates - and it proves your whole dairy pipeline works.

chain.title: Grilled Cheese
chain.desc: Bread, butter and cheese in the skillet. The first proper meal of the chain - solid hunger and saturation from ingredients a starter farm already produces on its own.

chain.title: The Roller
chain.desc: A log between two sticks. The roller flattens dough into pasta and, more importantly, presses nuts, seeds and vegetables into cooking oil.

chain.title: Press Cooking Oil
chain.desc: Roller plus any nuts or vegetables gives 2 oil - canola from the crops mod gives 4. Everything deep-fried wants oil: fries, fried chicken, donuts. Stockpile it.

chain.title: The Juicer
chain.desc: Four terracotta. The juicer squeezes every fruit into juice and smoothies, and it has one savory trick: it turns a single egg into mayonnaise.

chain.title: Mayonnaise
chain.desc: One egg in the juicer. This is Food Core's only condiment, and burgers, hot dogs and sandwiches all require 'a condiment' - so this humble jar gates the entire sandwich board.

chain.title: The Cutting Board
chain.desc: Copper, stick, plank on a diagonal. The board assembles sandwiches, slices jerky and plates full dinners - the last tool between you and the burger.

chain.title: Grind the Beef
chain.desc: Grinder plus raw beef. Ground meat cooks into its own food, but its real job is patties - every hamburger in Food Core and the Extended pack starts here.

chain.title: First Hamburger
chain.desc: Skillet, ground beef, your mayonnaise and bread. The full production line pays off: farm to grinder to condiment to burger. Cheese and bacon versions are one ingredient away.

chain.title: Fries
chain.desc: Pot, a potato, cooking oil and salt. Cheap, filling, and one of the two halves of fish and chips - your oil press starts earning its keep here.

chain.title: Fried Chicken
chain.desc: Pot, flour, raw chicken and oil. Better food than cooked chicken from the same bird, and a required part of the Chicken Dinner plate at the end of this chain.

chain.title: Mashed Potatoes
chain.desc: Bowl, baked potato, butter and salt. The second component of the Chicken Dinner - and proof that even a furnace product can be upgraded with your dairy line.

chain.title: The Saucepan
chain.desc: Just a stick and a copper ingot - the cheapest tool, saved for the sweets: caramel, chocolate, yogurt, marshmallows and every candy in the mod come out of this pan.

chain.title: Caramel
chain.desc: Saucepan, sugar and milk. Caramel headlines its own donut, pie, ice cream and fudge line - and a caramel apple is the fastest way to use one.

chain.title: Chocolate Bar
chain.desc: Saucepan plus cocoa beans. The bar is eaten as-is or melted into smores, fudge, cake and hot chocolate - the other pillar of the candy aisle.

chain.title: Simmer Some Stock
chain.desc: Pot plus a bone or any raw meat gives 2 stock. Stock is the soup backbone - noodle soup, pot roast, stew and the Extended pack's ramen and gravy all start with it.

chain.title: Winner Winner
chain.desc: Cutting board, fried chicken, mashed potatoes and a vegetable: a three-recipe-deep plated dinner that exercises every tool you built. This is Food Core's graduation meal.

notes: Verified against pamhc2foodcore-1.20.4-1.0.5.jar found in the a large test pack instance: 181 item lang keys, 181 recipe files read directly. Order is real dependency: the 9 tools (pot/skillet/saucepan need copper ingots + sticks, grinder andesite, bakeware/juicer terracotta, bowl/roller/board wood) are never consumed and gate everything - recipes reference them via forge:tool_* tags, so other kitchen mods' tools also satisfy them. freshwater_x8/freshmilk_x8 recipes convert one bucket into 8 units. forge:condiments in this jar contains only mayonaise (juicer + egg), which is why mayo precedes the hamburger. Chain caps at chickendinneritem (friedchicken + mashedpotatoes + vegetable on the cutting board). epicbaconitem (cooked pork + all 7 dye tags in bakeware) sits in the candy/novelty collection. Collections group the mechanical donut/jerky/potpie/pie/yogurt/candy/icecream/juice families, each hubbed on its plainest member. This mod is the tool-and-ingredient backbone for pamhc2foodextended - its tags (forge:flour, forge:dough, forge:cheese, forge:stock, forge:batter) are what Extended's 800+ recipes consume.
